subject: HealthBridge: vendor prefill + encryption & residency clarifying items
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ava Reynolds <ava@healthbridge.ai>, J. Morales <jmorales@healthbridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + prefills we promised (SIG/hosting/encryption)

Hi Ava / Jorge — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay synced: 

Summary of our discussion:
- You’re evaluating Redwood to serve embeddings and chat features for PHI-aware workflows in a subset of your product (clinical notes ingestion, triage assistant).
- Primary gating items: (1) SOC 2 status and evidence, (2) hosting/residency options for customer data, (3) key management/encryption model (BYOK vs Redwood-managed), and (4) expected questionnaire format (SIG Lite vs CAIQ vs custom).

What we’re attaching / next steps:
- Attached: redwood-sig-prefill-template.xlsx — we can prefill the SIG Lite/CAIQ where helpful; please flag which form you prefer.
- Attached: redwood-soc2-summary-2026.pdf — high-level SOC 2 summary and the responder for SOC artifacts. Full SOC report available under NDA if you want the actual attestation.
- I’ve CC’d Kimberly (Security) and Karthik (Solutions) to take point on technical clarifications and evidence mapping.

Two clarifying asks from our side to help prioritize evidence: 
1) Scope: Will HealthBridge’s integration send PHI to Redwood for inference (e.g., full notes) or will you only send deidentified/sampled payloads initially? If PHI, is the data flagged as HIPAA-covered across all accounts?
2) Residency: Do you need US-only hosting (single region) or are you evaluating EU residency as well for some customers? If EU, approximate volume splits help us recommend an architecture.

Optional but helpful: any existing questionnaire (your procurement packet) or a short list of dataflow diagrams. I included a folder link where we’ll drop prefilled forms once you confirm the target questionnaire.

Proposed timeline: once you confirm the questionnaire type and scope (questions 1/2 above), Kimberly will map required evidence and Karthik will propose an ops/config plan (BYOK vs Redwood KMS, VPC options) within 3 business days.

Would you be available for a 30-min follow-up Friday 4/9 at 10am PT to review prefill suggestions? If that doesn’t work I’ll suggest alternatives.

Thanks — Mina
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: redwood-sig-prefill-template.xlsx (excel), redwood-soc2-summary-2026.pdf (pdf)

From: Ava Reynolds <ava@healthbridge.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: J. Morales <jmorales@healthbridge.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + prefills we promised (SIG/hosting/encryption)

Thanks Mina — appreciate the clear next steps. Quick replies to your asks: 

1) Scope: yes, initial integration will send PHI (clinical notes) for inference. We plan a phased rollout; Phase 1 sends full notes for a pilot cohort. HIPAA applies across the pilot accounts.

2) Residency: primary need is US-only for the pilot. We are evaluating EU-hosted options for Q4 for certain EU customers, but not required for the initial deployment.

Questionnaire preference: procurement prefers SIG Lite for initial vendor assessment and may request a CAIQ later if the CISOs want deeper cloud controls. Please prefill SIG Lite.

We can do Friday 4/9 10am PT — confirmed. I’ll upload a brief dataflow diagram and our procurement packet (if helpful) after lunch.

—Ava
Ava Reynolds
Head of Procurement | HealthBridge AI

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Reynolds <ava@healthbridge.ai>, J. Morales <jmorales@healthbridge.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick recap + prefills we promised (SIG/hosting/encryption)

Thanks — looping in a few technical clarifications so we provide exactly the evidence you’ll need: 

A couple of follow-ups for HealthBridge (Ava / Jorge):
- Evidence granularity: for SOC 2 we can provide a redacted attestation and control narrative; will a redacted report satisfy procurement or do you require a full SOC 2 report under NDA?
- PHI processing mode: confirm whether HealthBridge will request that Redwood redact/store derivative telemetry vs store raw inference inputs for troubleshooting. If you need raw inputs retained, we’ll need to confirm retention windows and access controls per HIPAA (we have options to limit retention to 0–7 days for pilot).
- KMS/BYOK: we support both Redwood-managed KMS and customer-managed keys (AWS KMS/HSM integration). For BYOK we’ll need an estimated key rotation cadence and whether HealthBridge requires key custody proofs.

Action items from Redwood security: 
- We will prefill SIG Lite (sheet 1) and highlight cells that need HealthBridge input.
- I’ll prepare a short evidence pack with common artifacts: network diagrams, encryption-at-rest config, SOC 2 summary, access-control matrix, and an ops runbook describing our ephemeral retention for pilots. Expect that pack by EOD Thu.

If HealthBridge can upload the dataflow diagram and procurement packet, that will speed mapping.

—Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: healthbridge-dataflow-diagram.png (placeholder)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ava Reynolds <ava@healthbridge.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + prefills we promised (SIG/hosting/encryption) — calendar + next steps

Great — confirmed for Fri 4/9 10am PT (calendar invite sent). Quick checklist for the call so we can be efficient: 

Please upload before the call (or drop links in reply):
- One-page dataflow diagram (high level) — HealthBridge engineering
- Procurement packet / any mandatory fields in your SIG Lite — procurement
- If SOC 2 full report is required, send NDA contact (we’ll route).

What Redwood will have ready for the meeting:
- Prefilled SIG Lite (highlighted fields) in drive link.
- Evidence pack (redacted SOC 2 summary, network diagram, retention policy excerpt).
- Options comparison: BYOK vs Redwood KMS + expected ops changes and estimated lead times.

If anything changes on your side this morning, reply to this thread and we’ll adjust. See you on the call.

Thanks — Mina
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
